name: my-kpi-management

scripts.test:kpi-regression: npm run test:pulse-v2 && npm run test:kpi-save-lifecycle && npm run test:kpi-grid-display
scripts.test:weekly-activities: rm -rf .test-dist && tsc tests/*.test.ts --outDir .test-dist --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2020 --esModuleInterop --strict --skipLibCheck && node .test-dist/tests/weeklyActivitiesApi.test.js && node .test-dist/tests/weeklyActivityEditorSession.test.js && node .test-dist/tests/weeklyActivitiesUiContract.test.js && node .test-dist/tests/navigationWeeklyActivitiesFixes.test.js && rm -rf .test-dist
